show_language_selector.label: Show language selector
show_language_selector.info: Shown when the store has more than one published language.

show_social.label: Show social media links
show_social.info: Links come from Theme settings > Social media and Business details.

accessibility_page.label: Accessibility statement page
accessibility_page.info: Linked at the bottom of every page. Israeli law (IS 5568) requires an accessibility statement.

business_info.content: The business name, business ID and address at the bottom come from Theme settings > Business details.

logo_info.content: The logo comes from Theme settings > Brand.

show_heading.label: Show heading
show_heading.info: When hidden, screen readers still announce it.

heading.info: Leave empty to show the menu's own title, translated with the menu.

info.content: Phone, email and WhatsApp come from Theme settings > Business details.
Subscribers are added to Customers with the "newsletter" tag and consent to email marketing.

show_title.label: Show page title
show_title.info: When hidden, screen readers and search engines still get it.

show_card.label: Show contact card
show_card.info: WhatsApp, phone and email come from Theme settings > Business details.

heading_tag.info: Use H1 when this is the main section of the page, as on the team orders page.

whatsapp_label.label: WhatsApp button label
whatsapp_label.info: The WhatsApp number comes from Theme settings > Business details. Leave empty to use the default text, which is already translated into every store language.

show_form.label: Show quote request form
show_form.info: Requests arrive at the store's email address, like contact form messages.

preset.label: Ready-made text
preset.info: Already translated into every store language. A title and text of your own replace it.

show_heading.label: Show heading
show_heading.info: Hide it when the page title already says the same.

enable_schema.label: Add FAQ structured data for search engines
enable_schema.info: Use it on one page only, where the questions are the main content.

preset.label: Ready-made text
preset.info: Already translated into every store language. A question and answer of your own replace it.

show_heading.label: Show heading
show_heading.info: Hide it when the page title already says it, as on the size guide page.

adult_chart.label: Adult size chart
adult_chart.info: A "Size chart" entry from Content > Metaobjects. Without one, measuring tips are shown.

kids_chart.label: Kids' size chart
kids_chart.info: Optional. Without one, the standard kids' table by height is shown.

show_help.label: Show WhatsApp help
show_help.info: Needs a WhatsApp number in Theme settings > Business details.

info.content: Shows the details from Theme settings > Business details. Only the details you filled in appear.

show_channels.label: Show phone, email and WhatsApp
show_channels.info: Turn off where a contact card already shows them, for example on the contact page.

text.info: Shown when the password page message in Online Store > Preferences is empty. Leave empty to use the default text, which is already translated into every store language.

show_signup.label: Show email sign-up
show_signup.info: Sign-ups are saved as customers tagged "prospect" and "password page".
